message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|
| **Siam** | 123 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | Pad Thai (vegetarian version), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian) |
| **Baan Thai** | 456 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | Green Curry (vegetarian), Stir‑fried Tofu, Vegetarian Spring Rolls |
| **Thai House** | 789 W. Lake St., Chicago, IL 60607 | Pad See Ew (vegetarian), Vegetarian Satay, Thai Basil Tofu |
| **Siam Square** | 321 S. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60605 | Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Vegetarian Tom Kha, Vegetarian Fried Rice |
| **Siam Restaurant** | 654 N. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60610 | Vegetarian Massaman, Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao, Vegetarian Spring Rolls |

These restaurants typically offer a range of vegetarian options, but it’s always a good idea to call ahead or check their menus online to confirm availability and any seasonal changes. Enjoy your meal!
